Working with bcns starts with Connect, our data connector, at $200/month and nothing to pay upfront. Custom work sits on top of that: Deluxe builds start at $5,000 in setup fees and then $300/month in addition to your Connect subscription, and the $5,000 is a starting price rather than a fixed quote.

For businesses that mainly want advice on using AI, consulting runs $1,000 a day. Tell us what your team is trying to do and we'll come back with a scoped price.
